{{Wireless adapter |brand=Netgear |model=GTV100 |revision= |upc= |ean= |asin= |price= |est_release_date= |fcc_date=11/26/2012 |manuf_country=China |manuf=Wistron NeWeb |manuf_model=DHSM-87B |manuf_rev= |if=SDIO (module) |vendor_id= |device_id= |subvendor_id= |subdevice_id= |fcc_id=PY312200201 |ic_id= |chip1_brand=Marvell |chip1_model=88W8787 |chip2_brand= |chip2_model= |chip3_brand= |chip3_model= |flags=bluetooth |ant_conn=U.FL |802dot11_protocols=bgn |txchains=1 |rxchains=1 |sstreams=1 |oui= |lin_driver= |win_driver= }} This is the wireless module for the NeoTV Prime.
This device uses 88W8787-BKB2. "2011/11/17" and "48DHSM01.0GA" is silkscreened on the board in the FCC photos.
Labels affixed to the device in the FCC photos indicate the device has BT and WiFi OUIs of 90:A4:DE ('''Wistron NeWeb'''), but it would assumed the device manifests with '''Netgear''' OUIs in production models (or via software).
